name: 宛先と資料の閲覧権限を確認する共有欄
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual Lighthouse component LH15-0014, sharing recipient/view-permission field with no-contact-found state, no full app/device.
Image1 ORIGINAL primary for visible focus/caret, field alignment, spacing and fine control details; use source x47 y371 w1084 h651 only. Original recipient input is focused with caret, permission beneath and centered, thin divider, no-contact message, centered contacts-search action. Image2 OUR MOCK secondary for exact Japanese content and typography, not authority for omitted caret or cramped permission placement. Image3 approved white material craft only.
Visible text EXACTLY: "送信先"; recipient "佐藤 はるか"; permission "閲覧可能"; message "この共有先は連絡先にありません"; action "端末の連絡先を検索". No actual email or other name. Preserve space in Japanese name.
Logical typography Meiryo Bold12/16px section label, Regular14/24px recipient/message/search, Regular12/16px permission, tracking0. No oversized/bold new titles.
Compact logical390px-wide white group with16px insets: label top-left, recipient on next line with small visible caret after name, permission centered beneath like original, thin neutral divider, no-contact message below, centered search link last. Full text readable without clipping. Restore original fine alignment/focus, use compact spacing without source-page empty height.
Pure#FFFFFF canvas/white surface; subtle neutral edge and soft shadow if useful, restrained rounded group corners, no nested cards. Main ink#1D1D1D, supporting#6E6E6E. Source blue focus caret and search are real focused/action cues: adapt consistently to forest-green#1F6444. No icons exist in this source region, so invent none. No broad mint/tinted fills, random accent, CTA button or gradient; search remains quiet text action.
Original details override rough mock. Preserve focused recipient and missing-contact state; no source header/cancel/share button/keyboard, extra controls, new recipients, metrics, English, IDs, watermark or annotations. Static candidate, no actual sharing or contact search.
reviewNotes: 原図・自作を開いて比較し、原図の入力フォーカス／キャレットと権限の下段中央配置を優先して復元。生成を目視：送信先／佐藤 はるか／閲覧可能／連絡先未登録メッセージ／端末の連絡先を検索を保持。実際の焦点と操作の青をブランド緑へ統一。余分な共有ボタンやアイコンなし。厳密な文字メトリクス・所有者承認・編集性・実装は未確認。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
